verdict.rationale: pnpm documents itself as a drop-in replacement that can be pointed at any existing npm project with no rewrites (pnpm-docs-17, pnpm-docs-2). It auto-converts existing workspace declarations into a generated pnpm-workspace.yaml on the first install (pnpm-docs-46), and offers a hoisted nodeLinker that reproduces the npm/Yarn Classic layout for compatibility (pnpm-docs-45). Community reports confirm real migrations from yarn and Lerna+npm, though they needed hoisting fixes and repairs for undeclared transitive deps (pnpm-comm-8, pnpm-comm-12, pnpm-comm-16, pnpm-comm-9). Missing for 10: documented import/conversion of an existing npm or yarn lockfile, a dedicated migration guide, and a friction-free path for packages that rely on undeclared dependencies.
